# laravelforge_server_php_site_version (Data Source)

Fetches the default site/FPM PHP version for a Laravel Forge server.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server whose default site PHP version is fetched.

### Read-Only

- `binary_name` (String) PHP binary name (e.g. `php82`).
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `status` (String) PHP version status.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
- `version` (String) PHP version as reported by Forge.
